title: Integro — Loan Recovery & Financial Operations Platform
role: Product Engineer — Workflow Automation & Search Integration
description: Developed product features for Integro, a financial loan recovery platform managing recovery workflows at {{CURRENT_COMPANY}}. Customized Frappe/ERPNext DocTypes, workflows, and validations for loan lifecycle and compliance processes. Built backend REST APIs to manage loan records, recovery stages, and operational transactions. Integrated Amazon OpenSearch for high-speed frontend search, filtering, and data exploration.
problem_statement: Managing complex loan recovery lifecycles and stage transitions manually led to inefficiencies, compliance risks, and slow data access. Teams needed high-speed search across large loan datasets and automated workflow stage transitions.
design_decisions: Customized Frappe/ERPNext DocTypes and workflows to map real-world loan recovery lifecycles
Integrated Amazon OpenSearch to enable rapid search and filtering over large volumes of recovery data
Built robust REST APIs to secure and handle operational transactions between frontend and database
Developed automated stage transition scripts to reduce manual human intervention
Created custom reports and metrics dashboards to monitor API performance and collection KPIs
Collaborated with product managers, QA teams, and stakeholders to deliver scalable system enhancements
impact_metrics: Replaced manual stage transition tracking with automated workflow automation
Supported sub-second search and filter operations on millions of loan records using OpenSearch
Enabled real-time visibility into collection and recovery metrics for operations teams
Delivered a performant, production-ready financial operations platform

title: P2P & Concurrent Audit System
role: Software Engineer — Core ERP Customization & Portal Design
description: Developed a Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Concurrent Audit system for Quess Corp. Customized ERPNext modules including Purchase Order, Material Request, and Purchase Receipt workflows. Built a Vendor Onboarding Portal integrated with ERPNext procurement processes.
problem_statement: Procurement processes and concurrent audits were manual and lacked alignment, resulting in slow vendor onboarding, audit delays, and limited transaction visibility.
design_decisions: Custom-tailored ERPNext Purchase Order, Material Request, and Purchase Receipt workflows to fit corporate policies
Designed and built a dynamic Vendor Onboarding Portal linked directly to the core procurement backend
Developed automated audit scripts to flag compliance issues in real time during the P2P lifecycle
Implemented custom reporting dashboards to track procurement timeline efficiency
Created automation scripts and reports to improve financial process visibility and efficiency
impact_metrics: Automated procurement check gates and concurrent audits across the corporate lifecycle
Streamlined vendor onboarding and communications via the unified portal
Significantly reduced audit cycle time and invoice discrepancy rates
Improved financial process visibility and operational efficiency

title: adrEdge — Online Dispute Resolution (ODR/ADR) Platform
role: Product Engineer — Legal SaaS & Ledger Integration
description: Contributed to adrEdge, a SaaS-based Online Dispute Resolution and Alternate Dispute Resolution platform built for banks, NBFCs, and HFCs to resolve commercial disputes and accelerate loan recovery cycles. Built the accounting module on Frappe ERPNext v16, including setup and configuration of the Chart of Accounts and core accounting settings.
problem_statement: Traditional dispute resolution is slow, paper-heavy, and disconnected from financial ledger systems, making it difficult for financial institutions to resolve defaults and align settlements with core accounting.
design_decisions: Built a compliant online dispute resolution framework supporting arbitration, mediation, and conciliation workflows
Designed and configured the Frappe ERPNext v16 accounting module, including custom Chart of Accounts and ledger rules
Customized DocTypes and workflows to align dispute cases with case-related financial record-keeping
Worked within a legally compliant framework supporting online arbitration, mediation, and conciliation (Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996)
impact_metrics: Accelerated loan recovery cycles for banks, NBFCs, and HFCs
Standardized case ledger record-keeping and case resolution accounting
Provided a secure, legally compliant framework supporting online arbitration and mediation

title: Ifindex — Loan Recovery Application
role: Software Engineer — ETL Pipelines & Data Indexing
description: Automated data ingestion and transformation workflows using Apache Airflow. Integrated Amazon OpenSearch for scalable search and filtering across loan datasets. Built APIs to synchronize operational data and support reporting systems.
problem_statement: Large quantities of financial and loan data were scattered across disjoint systems, causing delays in operational reporting and rendering search operations slow and resource-heavy.
design_decisions: Implemented Apache Airflow to orchestrate and automate nightly ETL data ingestion pipelines
Leveraged Amazon OpenSearch for performant, distributed indexing and search capabilities
Built secure synchronization APIs to ensure real-time consistency of operational data
Configured role-based permissions and multilingual support
impact_metrics: Automated nightly data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Apache Airflow
Supported sub-second search and filter operations across large financial datasets
Enabled real-time consistency of operational data across systems

title: Sai Sparsh App — SSSIHMS

design_decisions: Designed a modular healthcare system architecture on top of the Frappe Framework
Implemented role-based access controls for doctors, patient portals, and admin staff
Developed backend APIs and DocTypes to support appointment bookings and electronic medical records (EMR)
impact_metrics: Replaced fragmented booking systems with a unified patient-care workflow
Streamlined doctor scheduling, appointments, and care workflows
Improved patient records management and overall operational coordination
